{{Quote|I swear on my name and the names of the ancestors… That I shall walk the Way of the Mand'alor… And the words of the Creed shall be forever forged in my heart. This is the Way.|Ragnar reciting the Way of the Mandalore creed|<ref name="Apostate" />}}
'''Ragnar Vizsla'''<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|223|Embodying Vizsla}}</ref> was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[Mandalorian]] and the [[Foundling]] son of [[Paz Vizsla]]<ref name="The Foundling" /> who in [[9 ABY]]<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate|17}}</ref> joined the [[Mandalorian]] [[Religion|sect]] the [[Children of the Watch]] lead by a [[Gender|woman]] known as "[[the Armorer]]."<ref name="Apostate" /> Not long after his induction, he was defeated by fellow foundling [[Din Grogu|Grogu]] in a combat training session. The session was interrupted when Ragnar was abducted by a large [[shriek-hawk]]. The shriek-hawk swallowed Ragnar whole before it attempted to feed him to its [[Youngling|young]]. A rescue party led by [[Bo-Katan Kryze]] that included Paz Vizsla and [[Din Djarin]] recovered Ragnar from the creature's nest one day later.<ref name="The Foundling" /> Ragnar, along with the rest of the covert, moved to the planet [[Nevarro]].<ref name="Spies">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 23: The Spies}}</ref>

Ragnar, along with the rest of his covert and Kryze's tribe, returned to Mandalore. There, he completed the ritual that was interrupted by a [[lake monster]] in the waters by the Mandalorian covert. He was later present at the reactivation of the [[Great Forge]], in which he celebrated along with the rest of the Mandalorians.<ref name="Ch. 24">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 24: The Return}}</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Ragnar Vizsla first appeared in "[[Chapter 17: The Apostate]]", the first episode of ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'' [[The Mandalorian Season Three|season three]],<ref name="Apostate" /> which was released on [[March 1]], [[2023]].<ref name="Tweet">{{Twitter|starwars|status/1598416900689743873|[[Star Wars]]|date=2022-12-1|quote=The Mandalorian and Grogu return March 1 only on @DisneyPlus.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/ytQHE}}</ref> The character was portrayed by [[Wesley Kimmel]],<ref name="Apostate" /> who previously played a [[Unidentified Tusken Raider youngling|Tusken Raider child]] in the ''[[Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett]]''. Executive producer<ref name="Stranger in a Strange Land">{{BOBF|Chapter 1: Stranger in a Strange Land}}</ref> [[Jon Favreau]] and the crew thought Kimmel did a great job, so they figured he should get to show his face in a different ''[[Star Wars]]'' project.<ref name="Jimmy Kimmel">{{OfficialYouTube|channel=@JimmyKimmelLive|name=Jimmy Kimmel Live|video=6WcrU7QPiCc|text=Jon Favreau on The Mandalorian & Samuel L. Jackson's MOTHERF***ER Post Credits Scene for Iron Man}}</ref> Kimmel found it difficult to keep his role a secret for a year. On [[March 1]], [[2023]], he announced on [[Wikipedia:Instagram|Instagram]] that he was a guest starring in ''The Mandalorian''.<ref name="Wesley Kimmel Instagram">{{Instagram|username=i.am.wesley.kimmel|url=p/CpO9lIlOwFb|name=Wesley Kimmel|date=2023-03-01|quote=Let's go.....! Almost lost my mind keeping this a secret all year. So happy to FINALLY announce that I am guest starring on @themandalorian season three! Watch the premier tonight at 12am on @disneyplus!!|archivedate=20230428002306}}</ref> "[[Embodying Vizsla]]," an article by [[Jay Stobie (real person)|Jay Stobie]] in [[Star Wars Insider 223|''Star Wars Insider'' 223]], identified his surname as Vizsla.<ref name="Insider" />
